title: Detect actively clamped crowded metadata
result: Capture the computed line clamp and combine horizontal and vertical visible-text estimates for active clipping. Preserve roomy, multi-line and missing-metadata controls. Icon alignment and the private Modelos label with more than twelve visible characters remain open.
evidence: Package lint, type-check and build passed, as did normal and production Knip with --treat-config-hints-as-errors. The independently source-matched isolated command node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --coverage --maxWorkers=1 passed 118 files and 458 tests with original coverage thresholds: 98.1% lines, 95.4% functions and 91.82% branches. Earlier execution passed 452 tests with six CLI timeouts; those six timed out in both the directed retry and the published base control. Assertions, timeouts and coverage thresholds were unchanged. Independent review found no issues.
